ai.seo_question: Who are the Mukhlasin (chosen servants) in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase highlights the concept of *Ismah* (infallibility), identifying the Ahl al-Bayt as the ultimate *Mukhlasin* who are preserved from all sin and impurity. It underscores their exclusive status as the perfect exemplars of divine servitude, serving as the spiritual and temporal guides for the community after the Prophet.
